### Commonage: Art Exhibition by Emmanuel Matt

![Commonage Exhibition](news/commonage.jpg)

An art show by theNCF member Emmanuel Matt exploring the landscape in its relationship to the farmed and the wild. The oldest preserved field systems in the world are under the bogs at the Ceide Fields, and great stretches of the land around them are used as commonage. This land lies somewhere between the bog and the tilled, between nature and the hand of the human.

As an artist, I'm reworking the abstract and the figurative. Our landscapes become the subject of dreams, hopes and recollections of our past. Finding what is common between us and nature.
